task_description: Milestone 1 (Issue #3): build the mock-first AgentCore compliance-lab experiment platform. Deliver a pnpm/TypeScript monorepo, one shared finding/remediation/evidence domain contract with a BackendAdapter seam and a MockBackendAdapter, a large deterministic synthetic finding/evidence dataset, a basic agent catalogue (5-8 planned agents), visible MOCK/RECORDED/LIVE LAB badges, Amplify build/deploy + branch/preview conventions, a concise architecture doc, exact working build/test/run commands, and Preview A (AWS Config/Security Hub-style Cloudscape dashboard) implemented first. Entirely mock/synthetic — no AWS credentials required or used. Later milestones M2-M5 are out of scope for this delegation.
